items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You were saying something about a fellow named Dee Dee just on the tape. [INTERVIEWEE] What's his name? Dee Dee Taylor. ... He was saying drums. Bass drums.

ctx.x: Yeah. Now, I could tell you some of the persons in the band at home when I was a kid. Let me see. Walter Johnson, bass. Let me see. Alec Taylor, trumpet. Ben Cole, trumpet. Boyle Stevenson, trumpet. Boyle Stevenson, trumpet. Boyle Stevenson, trumpet. Weaver Jason, trumpet. William Stevenson, trumpet. Dan Sparks, alto. John Cole. Who was a solo alto. Joe Granson, baritone. I was a solo alto. He was a solo alto, Joe Granson, baritone, Robert Cooper.
The tape ran off on the first reel. This is the second reel we're doing now of you and Jim Robinson. You were saying something about a fellow named Dee Dee just on the tape.
What's his name? Dee Dee Taylor.
